title: Forza — Brand Guide
intro: Brand overview, customer profile, and selling angles for Forza.

sections.title: Brand Story
sections.content: Tagline: "Power Meets Elegance." Forza Cucina offers pro-style ranges with high-output burners and Italian design influence at competitive mid-range prices. Their 36-inch models feature up to 18,000 BTU burners and true convection ovens.

sections.title: The Right Customer
sections.content: Customers cross-shopping Bertazzoni and Fisher & Paykel who want similar styling at a lower price.

sections.title: Selling Angles
sections.content:
Key selling angles for Forza:

• High BTU output at mid-range pricing

• True convection oven standard

• Italian design influence

• Competitive with Fisher & Paykel on styling

• Growing brand recognition in independent channel
